caption: Birch and Evergreens (Gallitzin, PA: Nordstrom Nurseries, 1951). From the Henry G. Gilbert Nursery and Seed Trade Catalog Collection, U.S. Department of Agriculture, National Agricultural Library.
alt: Both sides of a 1951 nursery postcard: a photograph of a clump of white-barked paper birches on a lawn beside a house with green shutters; and the back, stamped by the U.S. Department of Agriculture library, with prices for birch saplings.
bibliography: Nordstrom Nurseries. Birch and Evergreens. Nordstrom Nurseries, 1951. Henry G. Gilbert Nursery and Seed Trade Catalog Collection, National Agricultural Library.
